3139.title: Workspace-mode picker uses machine-location wording
3139.rootCauseOneLine: The current-checkout selection is displayed through local/remote machine-location labels instead of its parsed workspace mode.
3139.proposedFix: Display Current checkout for the parsed local workspace mode in the trigger and menu while preserving machine identity and selection behavior.
3139.caveats: The visual capture uses the repository's deterministic Ladle fixtures; the focused component test directly exercises the production picker in two clean checkouts.
